correctness.rationale: At each output atom s, f_empty(1)=0 forces all outputs zero; otherwise the mixed implication makes the empty operation a proper finite filter of the input Boolean lattice, hence membership iff a unique nonempty T_s⊆X. The agent operation depends only on X∩T_s and is an arbitrary monotone Boolean function with false/true endpoints (M(|T_s|)−2 choices). Conversely these states satisfy the axioms. Ser deletes inactivity. Det with X=T\{t},Y={t} forces w({t})=1 for every t, hence disjunction of nonempty traces, yielding 2^n choices per output. Disjoint singleton-agent coalition combinations already satisfy independence. Independent literal axiom enumeration at n=2 gives [49,36,16,9], n=1 direct [2,1,2,1]. All n follow from finite filter normal form, not finite runs.
